ex.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.
ex.zh: 這間實驗室配備了最新的電腦。

ex.en: Our car is equipped with air conditioning.
ex.zh: 我們的車有配備冷氣。

ex.en: The ship is not equipped with radar.
ex.zh: 這艘船沒有配備雷達。

equip.en: to provide a place or person with the things needed

ex.en: The training will equip you with useful skills.
ex.zh: 這項訓練會讓你具備實用的技能。

ex.en: This course equips students to work in a global market.
ex.zh: 這門課讓學生具備在國際市場工作的能力。

equip.en: to give someone the skills or knowledge they need

ex.en: The founders own 60 percent of the company's equity.
ex.zh: 創辦人擁有公司六成的股權。

ex.en: We used the equity in our house to get a loan.
ex.zh: 我們用房屋淨值申請了貸款。

equity.en: the value of shares in a company, or the value of property after debts

ex.en: The policy promotes equity in education.
ex.zh: 這項政策促進教育公平。

ex.en: Pay equity between men and women is still a problem.
ex.zh: 男女薪資平等仍是個問題。

equity.en: fair and equal treatment of everyone

ex.en: The market will eventually reach equilibrium.
ex.zh: 市場最終會達到平衡。

ex.en: Yoga helps me keep my emotional equilibrium.
ex.zh: 瑜伽幫助我保持情緒平衡。

equilibrium.en: a state in which opposite forces are equal

ex.en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.
ex.zh: 平等受到憲法保障。

ex.en: The love of democracy is that of equality.
ex.zh: 熱愛民主，就是熱愛平等。

ex.en: The company supports gender equality in the workplace.
ex.zh: 公司支持職場性別平等。

equality.en: the state of being equal in rights and chances

ex.en: He equates wealth with happiness.
ex.zh: 他把財富等同於幸福。

ex.en: You can't equate nationalism with fascism.
ex.zh: 你不能把民族主義和法西斯主義混為一談。

ex.en: Don't equate being busy with being productive.
ex.zh: 不要把忙碌等同於有生產力。

equate.en: to think of one thing as being the same as another

ex.en: Cutting a cake into equal pieces is rather difficult.
ex.zh: 要把蛋糕切成大小相等的幾塊不太容易。

ex.en: A mile is equal to about 1,600 meters.
ex.zh: 一英里大約等於 1,600 公尺。

equal.en: the same in size, amount or value

ex.en: We are equal in the eyes of the law.
ex.zh: 在法律面前人人平等。

ex.en: Men and women should receive equal pay for the same work.
ex.zh: 男女同工應該同酬。

equal.en: having the same rights and chances

ex.en: One plus two equals three.
ex.zh: 一加二等於三。

ex.en: Six divided by two equals three.
ex.zh: 六除以二等於三。

equal.en: to be the same as, or as good as

ex.en: Both options are equally good.
ex.zh: 兩個選項一樣好。

ex.en: This is equally important for small businesses.
ex.zh: 這對小型企業同樣重要。

ex.en: We split the bill equally.
ex.zh: 我們平均分攤帳單。

ex.en: All employees should be treated equally.
ex.zh: 所有員工都應該受到平等對待。

equally.en: in parts of the same size or amount

ex.en: One dollar is equivalent to 110 yen.
ex.zh: 1 美元相當於 110 日圓。

ex.en: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
ex.zh: 去一趟美國相當於她兩年的薪水。

equivalent.en: equal in value, size or meaning

ex.en: That Japanese word has no equivalent in English.
ex.zh: 那個日文詞在英文中沒有對應的說法。

ex.en: The job requires a bachelor's degree or its equivalent.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要學士學位或同等學歷。

equivalent.en: something that has the same value or meaning as another thing

ex.en: Do you know where these equations come from?
ex.zh: 你知道這些方程式是怎麼來的嗎？

ex.en: It's stable because all the roots of this equation are negative.
ex.zh: 它是穩定的，因為這個方程式所有的根都是負數。

ex.en: Solve the equation for x.
ex.zh: 解這個方程式求 x。

equation.en: a statement in mathematics showing that two amounts are equal

ex.en: Cost is only one part of the equation.
ex.zh: 成本只是需要考量的其中一個因素。

ex.en: Price isn't part of the equation for her.
ex.zh: 對她來說，價格不在考慮範圍內。

equation.en: a group of things that must be thought about together

ex.en: There is no exact equivalence between the two words.
ex.zh: 這兩個字之間沒有完全對等的意思。

ex.en: The study tested the equivalence of the two treatments.
ex.zh: 這項研究檢驗兩種療法的效果是否相等。

equivalence.en: the state of being equal in value or meaning

ex.en: This hospital has a lot of new equipment.
ex.zh: 這家醫院有很多新設備。

ex.en: Be careful. That's an expensive piece of equipment.
ex.zh: 小心，那可是很貴的設備。

ex.en: We ought to buy some new office equipment: the stuff we've got is out of date.
ex.zh: 我們該買些新的辦公設備了，現在用的都過時了。

equipment.en: the tools and machines needed for a job or activity

ex.en: We need a more equitable way to share the work.
ex.zh: 我們需要更公平的方式來分攤工作。

ex.en: The two sides reached an equitable agreement after long talks.
ex.zh: 雙方經過長時間談判後達成了公平的協議。

ex.en: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
ex.zh: 赤道把地球分成兩半。

ex.en: It is hot all year in countries close to the equator.
ex.zh: 靠近赤道的國家一年到頭都很熱。

equalise.zh: 使平等、使相等；（比賽中）追平比分

ex.en: The new rule aims to equalise opportunities for all students.
ex.zh: 這項新規定的目的是讓所有學生的機會均等。

ex.en: Our team equalised in the last minute of the game.
ex.zh: 我們隊在比賽的最後一分鐘追平了比分。

ex.en: He scored an equaliser in the last minute of the game.
ex.zh: 他在比賽最後一分鐘進球追平了比數。

ex.en: The equaliser came just before halftime.
ex.zh: 追平比分的進球發生在中場休息前不久。

ex.en: Use the equaliser to turn up the bass on this player.
ex.zh: 用等化器來調高這台播放器的低音。

ex.en: The equaliser on my speaker has five settings.
ex.zh: 我喇叭上的等化器有五種設定。

ex.en: The equatorial regions are hot and rainy all year.
ex.zh: 赤道地區一整年都炎熱多雨。

ex.en: Equatorial forests are home to thousands of animal species.
ex.zh: 赤道森林是數千種動物的家。

ex.en: She won a medal in the equestrian event.
ex.zh: 她在馬術項目中贏得一面獎牌。

ex.en: The park has an equestrian trail for horse riders.
ex.zh: 這座公園有一條供騎馬者使用的步道。

ex.en: The equestrian guided her horse over the fence.
ex.zh: 那位馬術選手引導她的馬跳過了圍欄。

ex.en: Each equestrian waited quietly for their turn.
ex.zh: 每位騎士都安靜地等待輪到自己。

ex.en: The new law aims to equalize pay for men and women.
ex.zh: 這項新法律旨在讓男女薪資平等。

ex.en: He scored in the last minute to equalize the match.
ex.zh: 他在最後一分鐘進球，把比賽扳平。

ex.en: You can equalize the pressure by opening the valve.
ex.zh: 你可以打開閥門讓壓力平衡。

ex.en: The minister gave an equivocal answer to the question.
ex.zh: 部長對那個問題給了個模稜兩可的答覆。

ex.en: The test results were equivocal.
ex.zh: 檢查結果並不明確。

ex.en: She accepted the bad news with equanimity.
ex.zh: 她很平靜地接受了壞消息。

ex.en: He faced the crowd with calm and equanimity.
ex.zh: 他沉著冷靜地面對人群。

ex.en: The school accepts a certificate of equivalency instead of a diploma.
ex.zh: 學校接受同等學力證明來取代畢業證書。

ex.en: The chart shows the equivalency between miles and kilometers.
ex.zh: 這張圖表顯示英里與公里之間的換算對等關係。
